# postyour.art

> The vault for visual artists: capture artworks by photo and voice — the AI assistant structures
> title, technique, dimensions, price and the story behind each piece into a private, exportable
> vault. Free forever. Automated channels deliver catalogs, websites, social media posts and sales
> listings from the vault. A service by mas.art (Lippeck GmbH, Worpswede, Germany).

Key facts:

- Capture works entirely via Telegram (photo + voice message) or in the browser — no new app to learn.
- The vault stores: gallery of works, stories, dates/exhibitions, prices, full history, media archive.
- Data ownership promise: full ZIP export any time, permanent account deletion, no AI training on
  user data, no advertising use. AI processing only on explicit user command.
- Channels (automated publishing from the vault): print/PDF catalogs and labels, personal artist
  website, Instagram/Pinterest/YouTube/Facebook, Canva-integrated designs, Google presence,
  Shopify, selling on findyour.art, and a personal artist agency for competition and exhibition
  applications.
- findyour.art (companion platform, live): the collector-facing counterpart to postyour.art — an
  online shop fed directly from the vault. Works the artist releases appear for sale with photos,
  technique, tags and price; an AI gallery copywriter writes each product page from the vault's
  semantic knowledge (one paragraph on the work, one on the artist); every artist automatically
  gets their own collection page. Updates sync without duplicates and nothing goes live without
  the artist's approval. Presentation is free; commission only applies when a work sells.
  Presentation form: walkable 3D worlds instead of a catalog shop — an infotainment experience
  (live example: https://findyour.art/kuenstler/markus-lippeck), later also planned for TV and VR.
  Next stage: matching interested buyers to artworks and artists by preference and taste, up to
  individual, semantically rich presentations per visitor.
- Plans: Community (free forever) · Standard 9.90 €/month or 7.90 €/month billed yearly
  (5 GB storage, one channel, selling on findyour.art) · Premium 29 €/month or 24 €/month billed
  yearly (100 GB, three channels, artist-agency channel) · Professional support on request.
- Languages: English (default), German, French, Spanish, Italian, Portuguese, Russian —
  each at https://www.postyour.art/?lang=de|fr|es|it|pt|ru
- Currently in beta: personal onboarding, free access during the beta phase.

FAQ (short answers, also on the page at https://www.postyour.art/#faq):

- What is postyour.art? The vault for your art: capture works by photo and voice; AI structures
  title, technique, dimensions, price and the story. Free, exportable, the artist's property.
- What does it cost? The vault is free forever; Standard 9.90 €/month (7.90 € yearly),
  Premium 29 €/month (24 € yearly), professional support on request.
- Who owns the data? The artist. No third-party AI training, no advertising use, full ZIP export
  and permanent deletion at any time.
- How is a work captured? Photo plus two spoken sentences, in the browser or via Telegram; the
  AI assistant structures everything. No new app to learn.
- What are channels? Automated publishing from the vault: PDF catalogs/labels, artist website,
  social media, Canva, Shopify, selling on findyour.art, artist agency for applications.
- What is findyour.art? The collector-facing counterpart: art as a walkable 3D experience;
  released works are for sale there; presentation free, commission only on sale.
- Languages? Seven: German, English, French, Spanish, Italian, Portuguese, Russian.
